# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-05 from the 2026-11-05 Hub dump.

- 3,213,044 models tracked, 919,415 declare a base model, 952,659 parent links, 90,888 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
